subtitle.en: How El Niño / La Niña, the Indian Ocean Dipole and the Western-V steer Kenya's rains, harvests, food security and conflict — county by county.

intro.en: El Niño and La Niña are the ocean signals decision-makers act on. This notebook follows how that signal reaches each Kenyan county — through the Indian Ocean Dipole (short rains) and a partly-independent Western-V Pacific pattern (long rains) — and on to harvests, market prices, food insecurity and conflict. Pick a county to begin.
